free.question: Is MapMyRoots completely free to use?
free.answer: Yes, MapMyRoots is completely free with no hidden costs, subscription fees, or premium tiers. You can create unlimited family trees and access all features forever. We believe family history preservation should be accessible to everyone.

compare.question: How does MapMyRoots compare to Ancestry.com or MyHeritage?
compare.answer: Unlike paid services like Ancestry.com ($24.99/month) or MyHeritage ($12.95/month), MapMyRoots is completely free and focuses on family tree visualization rather than genealogical research. You own your data and can export it anytime in multiple formats.

export.question: What file formats can I export my family tree in?
export.answer: You can export your family tree as high-resolution images (PNG, JPG), PDF documents perfect for printing, or JSON data for backup and sharing with other genealogy software. No restrictions or watermarks.

register.question: Do I need to register or create an account?
register.answer: No registration required and no account needed. You can start building your family tree immediately. All your data is stored locally on your device, so you keep full control.

mobile.question: Can I use MapMyRoots on mobile devices?
mobile.answer: Yes, MapMyRoots works perfectly on desktop computers, tablets, and mobile phones. The responsive design adapts to your screen size while maintaining full functionality.

limit.question: How many people can I add to my family tree?
limit.answer: There's no limit! You can add as many family members as you want and create multiple family trees. Users have successfully created trees with hundreds of family members.

import.question: Can I import data from Ancestry.com or other services?
import.answer: Yes! Use the Import button in the builder to load a GEDCOM file (.ged) — the universal genealogy format supported by Ancestry, MyHeritage, FamilySearch, and most genealogy software. From those services, export your tree as GEDCOM, then import it here.

photos.question: Can I add photos of family members?
photos.answer: Yes — click Edit on any person and add a photo. Photos are resized and stored locally on your device.

print.question: How do I print my family tree?
print.answer: You can export your family tree as a high-resolution PNG or PDF file using the export menu in the builder. These formats are perfect for printing at any size, from standard paper to large format posters for family reunions.

backup.question: How do I back up my family tree data?
backup.answer: Regular backups are essential! Use the export feature to download your family tree as a JSON file. Save this file to your computer, cloud storage, or USB drive. You can reload it anytime using the import feature.

browsers.question: What browsers does MapMyRoots support?
browsers.answer: MapMyRoots works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend using the latest version of your preferred browser for the best experience.

share.question: Can I share my family tree with relatives?
share.answer: Yes! Export your family tree as an image, PDF, or JSON file and share it via email, cloud storage, or messaging apps. Recipients can view images/PDFs directly or import the JSON file into their own MapMyRoots to continue editing.

privacy.question: Is my family data private and secure?
privacy.answer: Absolutely! Your family tree data is stored locally on your device in your browser's storage (IndexedDB). It never leaves your device and we never see or access it. You have complete privacy and control over your family information.

collaborate.question: Can multiple people work on the same family tree?
collaborate.answer: While real-time collaboration isn't currently supported, you can share your family tree JSON file with others. They can import it, make changes, and send it back. You can then merge the updates into your version.

meta.description: Comprehensive glossary of genealogical terms and definitions. Learn essential vocabulary for family history research and family tree building with MapMyRoots.

og.title: Genealogy Glossary - Essential Terms for Family History Research
og.description: Master genealogical vocabulary with our comprehensive glossary. Essential terms and definitions for successful family history research.

hero.title: Genealogy Glossary
hero.subtitle: Master the language of family history research with our comprehensive collection of genealogical terms and definitions.

search.no_results_text: Try searching for a different term or browse by letter above.

abstract.name: Abstract
abstract.definition: An abbreviated transcription of a document that includes the date of the record and every name it contains. May also provide relationships or descriptions of the people mentioned.

affinity.name: Affinity
affinity.definition: A relationship created by marriage. It refers to the connection between a person and their spouse's blood relatives, or between a person and their relative's spouse.

ahnentafel.name: Ahnentafel
ahnentafel.definition: A German word meaning "ancestor table." This numbering system assigns each ancestor a number, making organization easier. The subject is #1, father #2, mother #3, etc.

ancestor.name: Ancestor
ancestor.definition: A person from whom one is descended, typically more distant than grandparents. Includes parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, and earlier generations.

ancestry.name: Ancestry
ancestry.definition: One's family or ethnic descent; the line of people from whom a person is descended. Also refers to the collective ancestors of a family.

autosomal_dna.name: Autosomal DNA
autosomal_dna.definition: DNA inherited from both parents that can help identify relatives within about 5-7 generations. Used in modern DNA testing for genealogy.

banns.name: Banns
banns.definition: Public announcements of an intended marriage, traditionally made in church on three successive Sundays before the wedding ceremony.

birth_record.name: Birth Record
birth_record.definition: An official document recording the birth of a person, typically including name, date, place of birth, and parents' names.

brick_wall.name: Brick Wall
brick_wall.definition: A genealogical term for a research obstacle where no additional information can be found about an ancestor, creating a dead end in research.

census.name: Census
census.definition: An official count and survey of a population, typically including names, ages, occupations, and family relationships. Conducted periodically by governments.

family_tree.name: Family Tree
family_tree.definition: A chart showing family relationships in a tree structure, displaying ancestors, descendants, and collateral relatives.

genealogy.name: Genealogy
genealogy.definition: The study and tracing of family lineages and histories; the practice of researching and documenting family relationships.

hero.title: About MapMyRoots
hero.subtitle: Making family history preservation accessible, free, and privacy-focused for everyone.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To empower families worldwide to create, visualize, and preserve their family histories without barriers. We believe that documenting your heritage should be free, simple, and private - accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford expensive genealogy software.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: MapMyRoots was born from a simple frustration: why is creating a family tree so expensive and complicated? Most genealogy services charge monthly fees, lock your data behind paywalls, and make the process overwhelming for beginners.
story.paragraph2: We created MapMyRoots to solve this problem. Launched in 2023, our platform provides a completely free, intuitive family tree builder that respects your privacy. Your data stays on your device - we never see it, we never store it, and we never sell it.
story.paragraph3: Since our launch, families around the world have used MapMyRoots to preserve their heritage. From students completing school projects to grandparents documenting multiple generations, our tool serves families in their journey to understand where they come from.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.content: Your family tree data never leaves your device. We use your browser's storage (IndexedDB) to keep everything private and secure. No servers, no remote databases, no data collection - just you and your family history.

free.title: 100% Free Forever
free.content: No subscriptions, no premium tiers, no hidden costs. All features are free and always will be. Family history preservation shouldn't require a monthly payment.

simple.title: Simple & Intuitive
simple.content: We focus on making family tree creation easy for everyone. Drag-and-drop interface, visual canvas, and straightforward controls mean you can start building immediately - no training required.

accessible.title: Accessible to All
accessible.content: No registration required. Works on any device with a browser. Available in multiple languages. We believe everyone should be able to document their family story, regardless of technical skill or resources.

beautiful.title: Beautiful Design
beautiful.content: Your family history deserves to be presented beautifully. Our interactive canvas, customizable styles, and high-resolution exports make your family trees stunning works of art.

ownership.title: Your Data, Your Control
ownership.content: Export your family tree anytime in multiple formats (JSON, PDF, images). No vendor lock-in, no restrictions. Your data belongs to you, period.

why_free.title: Why Is MapMyRoots Free?
why_free.paragraph1: Great question! We believe family history preservation is a fundamental human activity that shouldn't be monetized. Unlike other genealogy services, we don't charge because:
why_free.reason1: Privacy-focused architecture: Since your data stays on your device, we don't need expensive servers or databases
why_free.reason2: No historical records: We focus on tree visualization, not genealogical research databases
why_free.reason3: Sustainable model: Our lean operation and efficient technology keep costs minimal
why_free.reason4: Community-driven: We're committed to serving families, not shareholders
why_free.paragraph2: We will never introduce paid features, subscriptions, or premium tiers. MapMyRoots will remain 100% free, forever.

technology.paragraph1: MapMyRoots is built with modern web technologies to ensure a fast, secure, and reliable experience:
technology.canvas: HTML5 Canvas: Smooth, responsive family tree visualization
technology.localstorage: IndexedDB: Secure, local data storage on your device
technology.responsive: Responsive Design: Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: MapMyRoots ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our free family tree builder application at mapmyroots.com (the "Service").

family_tree.title: 2.1 Family Tree Data
family_tree.content: All family tree data you create (names, dates, relationships, photos, notes) is stored locally on your device in your browser's storage (IndexedDB). This data:
family_tree.local: Never leaves your device or browser
family_tree.no_upload: Is not uploaded to our servers
family_tree.no_access: Cannot be accessed by us or any third party
family_tree.export: Can be exported and deleted at any time

analytics.title: 2.2 Analytics Data
analytics.content: We use Google Analytics 4 (loaded via Google Tag Manager) and Cloudflare Web Analytics to collect anonymous, aggregate usage statistics that help us improve the Service. This includes:
analytics.features: Feature usage in the builder (e.g., that a person was added or a tree was exported)
analytics.no_content: Important: Analytics events record only that an action happened. They never include names, dates, notes, photos, or any other content from your family tree.

cookies.title: 2.3 Cookies
cookies.content: We use the following types of cookies:

essential.title: Essential Cookies:
essential.content: Required for the Service to function (e.g., saving your language preference)

cookies.analytics: Analytics Cookies: Google Analytics sets the _ga and _ga_* cookies to distinguish visits and sessions. They expire after up to 2 years. Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless.

no_account.title: 3. No Account Required
no_account.content: MapMyRoots does not require you to create an account or provide any personal information such as:
no_account.name: Name
no_account.anonymous: You can use the Service completely anonymously.

data_security.title: 4. Data Security
data_security.content: Since your family tree data is stored locally on your device:
data_security.responsible: You are responsible for securing your device
data_security.export: We recommend regularly exporting your family tree data as backup
data_security.browser: Your data is subject to your browser's security and storage policies
data_security.clear: Clearing your browser data will delete your family tree

third_party.title: 5. Third-Party Services
third_party.content: We use the following third-party services:

google.title: Google Tag Manager & Google Analytics:
google.content: For anonymous usage statistics. See Google's Privacy Policy

third_party.cloudflare: Cloudflare Web Analytics: For anonymous, cookieless usage statistics. See Cloudflare's Privacy Policy

fonts.title: Self-hosted Fonts:
fonts.content: We self-host all fonts — no external font requests are made.

your_rights.intro: You have complete control over your data:

access.title: Access:
access.content: View your data anytime in the application

export.title: Export:

delete.title: Delete:

modify.title: Modify:

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy
children.content: MapMyRoots does not knowingly collect any personal information from users. Since we don't collect personal data, users of all ages can use the Service. However, we recommend parental supervision for users under 13.

international.title: 8. International Users
international.content: MapMyRoots is available worldwide. Since your data is stored locally on your device, it never crosses international borders through our Service. Aggregate, anonymous analytics data processed by Google and Cloudflare may be transferred internationally in accordance with their respective privacy policies.

data_retention.content: Your family tree data remains on your device until you:
data_retention.clear_app: Use the "Clear All Data" feature in the application

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

gdpr.title: 11. GDPR Compliance
gdpr.content: For users in the European Union, we comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
gdpr.local: Data Minimization: We only process the minimum data necessary (anonymous analytics)
gdpr.control: User Control: You have complete control over your family tree data

gdpr.consent: Consent: By using our Service, you consent to analytics as described

ccpa.content: MapMyRoots does not sell personal information. California residents have the right to:
